observations: Photo 0: A large flat-screen TV mounted on a wall, displaying a colorful image of a hand holding an ice cream cone in front of European-style buildings. The screen has a thin black bezel. A watermark 'POSTED ON Jiji' is visible. The photo timestamp is 04/09/2026 14:40, taken with a Xiaomi 12X.

Photo 1: The same TV showing a smart TV interface with app icons (Netflix, YouTube, Disney+, Spotify, etc.) and a background image of a hand holding sand. The screen is bright and clear. The same watermark and timestamp (04/09/2026 14:43) are present.
Photo 2: The TV displaying the same smart interface as photo 1, but with a different background image (same ice cream scene as photo 0). The watermark and timestamp (04/09/2026 14:40) are visible.
No visible brand or model name on the TV bezel or screen in any photo.
The TV appears to be wall-mounted, with a black cable visible at the bottom.

claims.claim: 50" samsung crystal clear premium uhd 4k hdr sleek design smart tv
claims.evidence: No brand or model visible on the TV in any photo. The screen content and design are consistent with a modern smart TV, but Samsung cannot be confirmed visually.
No on-screen display or settings menu showing resolution. The visual quality appears high, but resolution cannot be confirmed from photos alone.

risks.risk: The TV is not a Samsung, as claimed.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the TV bezel or back panel showing the brand name.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic 50-inch smart TV, not a Samsung, which would reduce value significantly.

risks.risk: The TV is not 4K UHD or HDR capable.
risks.proof: A screenshot of the TV's settings menu showing resolution and HDR support, or a video clip demonstrating HDR content.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a standard HD or Full HD smart TV, not 4K UHD HDR, which would reduce value.

risks.risk: The TV is damaged or has dead pixels, screen burn-in, or other defects not visible in the photos.
risks.proof: A video clip showing the entire screen with a solid white, black, and red/green/blue screen test, or a close-up of the bezel and ports.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially defective, with a discount for unseen damage.

risks.risk: The TV is not functional or has missing features (e.g., no internet connectivity, broken remote).
risks.proof: A video clip showing the TV turning on, navigating menus, and playing content from a streaming app.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, or with a significant discount for unverified functionality.

proof_requests: A clear photo of the TV bezel or back panel showing the brand and model name.
A video clip showing the TV's settings menu with resolution and HDR information.
A video clip showing the TV turning on, navigating menus, and playing content from a streaming app.
A photo or video of the TV with a solid color screen test (white, black, red, green, blue) to check for dead pixels or burn-in.
response.reason: The brand and model cannot be confirmed from the photos, and key claims (Samsung, 4K UHD, HDR) are unverified. Without proof of brand, resolution, and functionality, the item cannot be priced accurately. The risks of misrepresentation or defects are high.
